name: mod-handoff
description: Clear & Continue: summarizes the session into a handoff, clears, and fills it into the fresh prompt for review

animations.title: Animations
animations.description: Entries shimmer while they wait and hover colors fade. Off, everything draws still

max_words.title: Handoff length
max_words.description: Hard cap, in words, for the handoff message the model writes

pick_threads.title: Pick what carries over
pick_threads.description: Before writing, Haiku splits the session into up to four threads and asks which ones the handoff keeps. Off, it keeps everything

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: auto uses Nerd Font icons when Windows Terminal runs a Nerd Font, and safe Unicode glyphs elsewhere. nerd and safe force one
